text:
Alex P.: quick standup — quick flags for deals + sec asks.
Alex P.: MacroHealth is asking about HSM/KMS: they want on-prem HSM integration (PKCS#11) + audit logs. Any blockers from sec or infra?
Maria G.: FYI: MacroHealth POC still on for next Tue. I'm finalizing SOW. Main blocker: customer wants HSM-backed keywrap (not just KMS). They asked if we support FIPS 140-2.
Devon S.: @Sophie L. can you confirm whether Redwood Private supports PKCS#11 with our on-prem package? Also, will Dedicated cover this if they go hosted with private link?
Sophie L.: Short answer: Private on-prem supports HSM via our connector but needs configuration + kms-operator change. FIPS crypto libraries are supported but not all HSM vendors. I'll attach checklist.
Sophie L.: Checklist link: https://internal.redwood/plays/hsm-onboard (internal)
Sophie L.: Required: open ACE ticket (SEC-3421), vendor cert, and network policy for mgmt port. Also need to sign an NDA for vendor access.
Ben K.: Heads-up: I'm prepping a small PR to expose HSM env vars for the deploy script. @Devon S. can you review? PR: gitlab.com/redwood/infer/merge/224
Devon S.: can do, will review this afternoon.
security-bot: SEC-3421 created by Sophie L. — status: triage. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-3421
Alex P.: Next steps: (1) Sophie to confirm vendor compatibility + ACE ticket (2) Maria to update SOW with HSM clause (3) Ben to open PR and tag @Devon for review. If any of you need a quick async huddle, drop a :phone: emoji.
Maria G.: on it, will ping legal re: NDA.
Sophie L.: I'll post the vendor whitelist here by EOD and add required config snippet.
Sophie L.: config snippet:
```
HSM_PROVIDER=pkcs11
HSM_LIB=/opt/vendor/lib/libhsm.so
HSM_SLOT=0
```
Alex P.: cool, thanks all :thumbsup:
